title: Generic flatness for a finite type morphism of algebraic spaces over a reduced base

difficulty_reason: Counts the author Proposition: for a finite type morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over a scheme S with Y reduced and a finite type quasi-coherent sheaf F on X, there is an open dense W contained in Y over which the base change X_W -> W is flat, locally of finite presentation and quasi-compact and F restricted to X_W is flat over W and of finite presentation (source lines 6570-6585). The proof is a three-stage descent of the scheme statement: from a surjective etale V -> Y to Y, from an affine open covering to an affine base, and finally from the affine etale cover U -> X to the scheme case by applying Morphisms, Proposition morphisms-proposition-generic-flatness-reduced to U -> Y. The interest lies in the correct bookkeeping of the properties through etale descent rather than in a single hard computation.
